title: Tensor-generator extensionality on fixed scalar quotient models
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W, coefficient calculi SE,SL, scalar systems A and reduction-model data d [stage3-pur-extension-reduction-data]. For a good cochain complex K, degree i, strict coefficient-system module T and maps f,g:(d.direct K)^i→T, equality on every actual quotient section modelSection(n,U,b,x) implies f=g. The sections are inverse directEvaluation images of the finite pure tensors b tensor x, transported to the product sequence site by integralComparisonSequenceSection [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. This is ordinary module-map extensionality, not an assertion about derived finite-evaluation faithfulness.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4; the already proved generator-uniqueness step of quotientModels in lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence.

proof.text: Evaluate at each quotient n, precompose by the inverse of d.directEvaluation, and forget to abelian sheaves. The finite scalar tensor extensionality theorem reduces equality to the displayed sections, exactly the hypothesis. Sheaf and presheaf hom extensionality then assemble these equalities over all pairs (n,U), proving equality of the original strict module maps.

theorem quotientModelSection_hom_ext (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (A : CoefficientExtensionSystems.{u, u} l E L ι W)
    (d : CoefficientExtensionReductionData.{u, u} l E L ι W SE SL A)
    (K : (integralOperationsGoodComplex.{u, u} l E W).FullSubcategory) (i : ℤ)
    {T : coefficientSequenceModules.{u, u} l L W}
    (f g : (d.direct.obj K).X i ⟶ T)
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (b : (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l L W).obj.obj (op (n, U.unop)))
      (x : (K.obj.X i).val.obj U),
      f.val.app (op (n, U.unop)) (modelSection l E L ι W SE SL A d K n i U b x) =
        g.val.app (op (n, U.unop)) (modelSection l E L ι W SE SL A d K n i U b x)) :
    f = g
